en: A black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph showing a rural landscape with a prominent white church complex in the midground. The church has a tall square tower topped with a lantern and spire, surrounded by trees and several auxiliary buildings. Open fields stretch across the foreground, with low hills and a river or water body visible in the hazy background. In the lower left corner, printed text reads "Timrå kyrka."
